name: Classic Group
intro: One of Raipur's established developers. We repositioned the group as a premium lifestyle brand, rebuilt its creative system, and ran always-on campaigns that turned attention into site visits.
challenge: Classic Group markets several residential projects — Classic Castle, Classic Towers, Sumeet Landscape — to an aspirational buyer. The brand looked like a dozen other local developers, and the marketing had to feel premium and stay consistent across formats as different as an Instagram carousel, a highway hoarding and a full newspaper page.
approach: We rebuilt the identity around a single premium system, then built an always-on engine: a monthly creative series, AI-assisted walkthrough reels, an ad film, and an out-of-home rollout — hoardings, pole-kiosk routes and press. Every piece pointed to a lead form and was measured against cost per enquiry.
result: A consistent, premium presence across every touchpoint and 500+ qualified leads from the campaigns — with the brand finally looking like the market leader it is.

name: Customise World
intro: A personalised-gifting and wedding-hamper brand growing entirely on organic reach. One reel alone brought in 300+ new followers with no ad spend.

highlights.label: Followers from a single reel, organically

challenge: Customise World sells premium personalised gifting — baby announcements, wedding hampers, corporate boxes. The brief was growth without a media budget: the content itself had to do the work.
approach: We focused the feed on a few formats that travel — premium unboxing-style reels, announcement reels, and factory/behind-the-scenes cuts — and paired it with a properly designed 2025 digital catalogue and company profile so enquiries could be closed.
result: Steady organic follower growth, including 300+ new followers from a single baby-announcement reel, and a sales toolkit that looks as premium as the product.

name: Ruchikara
intro: A premium gourmet, chocolate and hamper brand. The content had to look as considered as the packaging.
challenge: Ruchikara competes with national gourmet names on the shelf and in the feed. Its social presence needed to feel indulgent and high-end, and to spike hard through Rakshabandhan and Diwali gifting season.
approach: We built a feed of stop-motion and voiceover reels, an AI hamper promo, and festive campaign creative delivered as sets — then packaged the season into a Diwali Hampers catalogue for direct sales.
result: A gourmet feed that holds its own beside the big brands, and a festive catalogue that turned the season into orders.

name: Kaaya Unisex Salon
intro: A premium unisex salon, built from the ground up — identity first, then a content engine that looked established from day one.
challenge: Kaaya opened into a crowded local salon market. It needed to look premium and current immediately — not like a new business finding its feet.
approach: We designed the Kaaya identity and delivered it as a full brand book, then ran the content: bridal and glam reels, an AI facial reel, myth-vs-fact and FAQ carousels, and a nails testimonial reel — all on one visual system.
result: A salon brand that reads as established and premium, with a feed that stays consistent week to week.

name: Riston Automobiles
intro: Engine oils and premium spare parts, positioned as the premium option in a price-led category.
challenge: A category that usually competes on discount. Riston needed to look like the upgrade.
approach: A run of premium, performance-led product creative and a product reel that treated engine oil like a hero product.
result: A sharper, more premium shelf and feed presence.

name: Gymsane – The Fitness Club
intro: A fitness club with a bold, high-energy presence across social and out-of-home.
challenge: Stand out in a city full of gyms with the same stock-photo look.
approach: A high-energy monthly creative series and a pole-kiosk route that made the brand unavoidable on the commute.
result: A distinct, ownable look on the feed and on the street.
